marco (infra-oncall): Heads-up — NIC firmware rolling reboot in apac-west2 next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted node drains + BMC soft reboots, expecting transient packet drops during egress handoff.

marco (infra-oncall): Plan: 6 cohorts, 20m drain each, 5m validation, canary first 2 nodes, then bulk. No planned model upgrades.

sara (ml-infra): Thanks. Which GPU pools are in cohort 3? need to decide KV cache priming window.

marco (infra-oncall): cohort mapping: cohort-1 = edge-rack-01-06, cohort-2 = edge-rack-07-12, cohort-3 = saturn-pools A-D (includes some dedicated drains). I'll paste the script we run for drain.

marco (infra-oncall): ```bash
./drain.sh --cohort cohort-3 --mode graceful --timeout 1200 
# drains pods, migrates active tasks, marks node unsched
```

ben (runtime): Re: dedicated pools — if we pre-warm fallback capacity in us-east1, latency SLOs for some customers should be fine. But that increases hourly cost by ~35% for the window. Do we want to buy burst capacity or rely on model fallbacks?

priya (capacity): Cost estimate: pre-warming 8 DGX instances for 3h ≈ $9.5k. Alternative: route 12% of traffic to quantized variants in eu-west temporarily — saves ~$7k but model quality risk. Need product ok.

nina (sre): Can we do staggered egress routing to avoid cross-region spikes? If we shift small % per cohort we can smoother the load. Ops-bot will enforce rate-limits.

ops-bot: Notice created: incident-prep/apac-west2-nic-fw-9498765432.linked -> Pager duty rotations set.

carlos (support): Heads-up for CS: two large hosted customers in apac-west2 might see retry spikes. I'll queue templated comms if we expect >2xx errors.

marco (infra-oncall): Canaries: please verify these two nodes: saturn-a-03, saturn-a-07. I'll run health checks at t+10m after reboot.

ben (runtime): I'll add soft-fallback policy: if p95 latency > 350ms for >2 cohorts we trigger cross-region fallback to us-east1. Adding a 3% traffic sample for quality monitor.

sara (ml-infra): KV cache: recommend seeding after each cohort with `kv-seed --cohort cohort-3 --prefixes=/top-1k-prompts` to avoid cold-cache penalties. That takes ~6 minutes. Put it in the cohort post-validate step.

priya (capacity): Scheduling note: can we shift the window by +1h to align with apac midnight? shifting reduces user impact but bumps cost for standby capacity. Preference: keep 02:00 UTC (local evening) per ops.

nina (sre): +1 on keeping 02:00 UTC. Operational team available, lower global traffic then. Confirmed with oncall.

marco (infra-oncall): Decision: keep 02:00-05:00 UTC. Action items:
- marco: run canary (saturn-a-03/07) and post results by 01:50 UTC
- sara: add kv-seed to post-validate step for each cohort
- ben: enable soft-fallback policy and 3% quality sampling
- priya: provision 4 standby DGX instances (reduced from 8) and provide final cost delta
- carlos: prepare CS comms template, mark high-touch customers
- nina: monitor egress telemetry, escalate if packet-loss > 0.5% for >10m

marco (infra-oncall): Quick check — do we need a maintenance page? I can schedule a short banner on prod console for 3h. Thoughts?

carlos (support): Yes, please. Template: "Planned maintenance in apac-west2 may cause brief increase in request retries. No data loss expected." Keep it minimal.

ben (runtime): One more: add temporary `max_concurrency=1` for large-batch endpoints during cohorts to reduce tail latency.

sara (ml-infra): Will update CI job that runs rq benchmarks post-merge. Also will watch eval regression panels for quality drift during fallback.

priya (capacity): Standby cost estimate updated: 4 DGX for 3h ≈ $4.8k. Will provision and attach to standby pool by 01:30 UTC.

marco (infra-oncall): Perfect. I'll post the final runbook and cohort mapping at 01:20 UTC and ping oncall. If anyone has blocking concerns speak now or DM. :thumbsup:

nina (sre): LGTM. I'll coordinate postmortem template and ensure logs are archived to long-term storage.

carlos (support): Added CS cases for the two high-touch customers and linked runbook.

ops-bot: Runbook uploaded: s3://infra-runbooks/apac-west2-nic-fw-9498765432.md

marco (infra-oncall): Thanks team. See you in the run channel during the window.
